body: Kiko, practical test ko sa cycle signal: huwag muna bumili ng bagong course, tool, o certification dahil lang mataas ang PMI. Mas sulit i-convert ang signal into low-cost career optionality—update CV evidence, document measurable equipment/process wins, at watch actual openings and salary bands. If hiring demand really follows the orders/backlogs, saka may price signal sa labor market. Strong factory data is useful; spending money to chase the headline before employers pay for it is not.
